description: This file implements the MediaPipelineCapabilities class and related factory functions for media pipeline capabilities, including methods to retrieve supported MIME types and check MIME type support, with logging and exception handling.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media pipeline capabilities interface, providing methods to get supported MIME types and check MIME type support, using IPC factory for communication.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes IPC communication for media pipeline capabilities, throws if IPC cannot be created.

methods.name: ~MediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Destructor that resets the IPC pointer.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
